arguments.name: mayorGender
arguments.description: The player's chosen pronouns: female is she/her, male is he/him, other is they/them for one person. Always respect this choice for the mayor. For other, use natural neutral wording, such as la persona en la alcaldía in Spanish; the grammatical gender of persona does not imply the player's gender. Rephrase whole sentences, do not use binary slash forms or invented endings. The game passes mayorGender to every message.
